static_traits.name: Lin Xiao
static_traits.social_status: Has friends to confide Average problems in, but not yet discussing swimming doubts with them; relationship with swimming friends affected by avoiding joint activities
static_traits.medical_history: No similar problem history; not yet received psychotherapy or counseling; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Positive attitude, clear expression and highly cooperative, able to identify and describe emotions and thinking

basic_info.main_problem: I doubt whether I can continue swimming as I age, although I really like swimming. These doubts have lasted about a year and have gradually worsened to the point that I completely avoid swimming.
basic_info.core_demands: The decisive factor in this decision to seek counseling is the impact of these doubts on my mental health and lifestyle.
growth_experiences: About a year ago witnessed an older family member clearly struggling with physical activity, which triggered worry about one's own ability declining with age. Since then whenever thinking of swimming or Seeing others swim, the worry activates and gradually worsens. No similar psychological problems in the past, nor received psychotherapy; physical condition Good.

core_beliefs: Aging means my physical ability will inevitably decline, and eventually I will be unable to keep swimming
If I cannot complete training like I used to, it means I am no good

special_situations.event: Thinking about going swimming or making a swimming plan
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot complete a full swim training like before, it means I am already no good and should stop swimming
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Simply not swimming, to avoid failure and embarrassment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will soon be exhausted, unable to complete the training

special_situations.event: Seeing others swim in the pool
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot keep up with others, I will be embarrassed and looked down on
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids swimming with friends, reduces trips to the pool
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am surely worse than them; going would only be embarrassing

special_situations.event: Realizing one's physical fitness is Good as a Marathon runner, or thinking of older successful swimmers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Even with positive evidence, it is not enough to overturn the judgment that 'being old means no good'
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating or downplaying positive evidence to maintain the avoidance strategy
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These positive examples do not apply to me

special_situations.event: Recalls older relatives struggling during physical activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Seeing them struggle shows that no one at an older age can maintain athletic ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Treating the conclusion 'aging = cannot swim' as a Self-protection reason, continuing to avoid swimming
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Being old means definitely cannot swim

core_conflict.wish: Longing, in the process of growing old, to still be able to continue swimming competently and acceptably, maintaining a sense of ability and pleasure
core_conflict.fear: Fears failure and losing face in front of others, worries that aging will cause loss of ability
defense_goal: Avoids failure and shame by avoiding swimming
Keeps distance from peers to reduce the possibility of being judged

object_relations.self_representation: A self that may not keep up, easily failing
object_relations.object_representation: Others (friends / peers) who will judge me and embarrass me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking of going swimming with friends or receiving a friend's swimming invitation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: They will see I am no good and judge me (transference: projecting one's own shame and Self-doubt onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Declining invitations in a gentle but avoidant tone, being vague and displacing the topic, reducing self-exposure; avoiding expressing inner unease.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When pointed to positive evidence (Good fitness, seeing older successful swimmers)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Positive evidence does not apply to me; others are just exceptions
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using rationalizing language (e.g. 'everyone's situation is different' / 'I will fatigue faster with age') to maintain avoidance, steady tone, lowered emotions.

manifestations: Witnesses older family members' physical decline and struggling in physical activities
Worries about losing ability and acceptance with age
Anxiety rising whenever thinking of swimming or seeing others swim
outcomes: Overall decline in physical activity and enjoyment

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believing friends will look down on or judge whether one can keep up
Hence not discussing swimming doubts with friends

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treats 'growing old = inevitable decline in ability' as an absolute rule
Using this to self-limit and as a reason not to swim

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Avoids discussing one's doubts in social settings

positive_force: Good fitness foundation (Marathon runner, excellent physical condition)
Able to identify and mention counter-evidence (seeing older successful swimmers)
Willing to seek professional help and express inner feelings honestly
Having a friend support network (though not yet communicating on this topic)
negative_force: Catastrophizing about aging and tendency to predict the future
Overgeneralization and mental filtering, ignoring positive evidence
Negating positive thinking, hard to integrate positive information
Avoidance reinforcing doubts, leading to reduced activity and socializing
Worry about others' evaluation causing shame and Relationship tension

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding swimming and swimming activities with friends
antecedent: Being invited by friends to swimming activities
target_behavior.core_reason: After witnessing an older family member struggling with physical activity, forming the belief 'aging = unable to maintain athletic ability', with catastrophic and future-predicting worry about possible failure or embarrassment
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential failure and shame, maintaining short-term safety
target_behavior.consequence: Overall decline in physical activity and enjoyment; Relationship tension with swimming friends; lower Self-efficacy
